Light Control Rheostat (Digital Type)

INSPECTION OF LIGHT CONTROL RHEOSTAT

INSPECT RHEOSTAT OPERATION

Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal
1. Connect the negative (—) lead to terminal 4.

(a) With the brightness at minimum, check that there is
9V between terminals 1 and 3.

(b) Gradually turn the rheostat toward the brighter side
and check that the voltage between terminals 1 and 3
decreases from 9V to 0V.

(c) With the brightness at minimum, check that there is
0V between terminals 2 and 4 and 12V when brightness is at any other level.

If operation is not as specified, replace the rheostat.

[DIAGRAMS: Two technical drawings showing rheostat testing configurations]
